lines.trans: Well, Nikita, accept my congratulations now.
Listen, are you completely foolish already?
Kostya, forgive me for hiding it from you.
Thank you very much for everything good.
And I will pick up my things tomorrow.
Dad, let us go home to our place together right now.

Do not worry, we will definitely think of something.

examples.trans: Wait, my friend, do not rush to conclusions.

переживать.gloss: to worry, to fret; to go through

meanings.note: Prefix 'пере-' denotes crossing over, repeating, or exceeding a limit (stem 'живать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to worry, to fret; to go through', paired with 'пережить'.

examples.text: Ты всегда за них сильно переживаешь.
examples.trans: You always worry a lot about them.

examples.text: Не переживай, мы обязательно что-нибудь придумаем.
examples.trans: Do not worry, we will definitely think of something.

examples.text: Что вы так переживаете?
examples.trans: Why are you worrying like that?

meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'язательно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Только этот костюм мне обязательно верните.
examples.trans: Just be sure to return this suit to me.

examples.text: Хорошо, я обязательно что-нибудь для вас придумаю.
examples.trans: Fine, I will definitely think of something for you.

examples.text: Не переживай, мы обязательно что-нибудь придумаем.
examples.trans: Do not worry, we will definitely think of something.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'anything', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Хорошо, я обязательно что-нибудь для вас придумаю.
examples.trans: Fine, I will definitely think of something for you.

examples.text: Не переживай, мы обязательно что-нибудь придумаем.
examples.trans: Do not worry, we will definitely think of something.

examples.text: Скажи что-нибудь.
examples.trans: Say something.

придумать.gloss: to think up, to come up with

meanings.en: to think up, to invent, to come up with
meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'думать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to think up, to come up with', paired with 'придумывать'.

examples.text: Хорошо, я обязательно что-нибудь для вас придумаю.
examples.trans: Fine, I will definitely think of something for you.

examples.text: Не переживай, мы обязательно что-нибудь придумаем.
examples.trans: Do not worry, we will definitely think of something.

examples.text: Ты сам это придумал!
examples.trans: You came up with this yourself!

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Конечно, я сегодня очень сильно расстроился.
examples.trans: Of course, I got very upset today.

examples.text: Можем, конечно, и за Дениса выпить.
examples.trans: We can, of course, drink to Denis too.

examples.text: Конечно, дома за чаем всё обсудим.
examples.trans: Of course, at home over tea we will discuss everything.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'at home', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Папа, поехали сейчас вместе к нам домой.
examples.trans: Dad, let us go home to our place together right now.

examples.text: Конечно, дома за чаем всё обсудим.
examples.trans: Of course, at home over tea we will discuss everything.

examples.text: Поехали сейчас вместе домой.
examples.trans: Let us go home together now.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'tea' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Ой, большое спасибо за горячий чай.
examples.trans: Oh, thank you very much for the hot tea.

examples.text: А я вот вам чаю с сушками принёс.
examples.trans: I've brought you some tea and bread rings.

examples.text: Держи горячий чай.
examples.trans: Here's some hot tea.

meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'судить'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'will discuss', paired with 'обсуждать'.

examples.text: Ладно, давай попробуем сейчас всё обсудить.
examples.trans: Alright, let us try to discuss everything now.

examples.text: Конечно, дома за чаем всё обсудим.
examples.trans: Of course, at home over tea we will discuss everything.

examples.text: Без лишних ушей обсудим твоё назначение.
examples.trans: Without extra ears we will discuss your appointment.
